sources.evidence: Every launchable @cute.kernel entry point was inspected in the pinned local checkout, including its device body, reductions or pipelines, shared storage, and architecture-specific GEMM helpers.

authoring.goal: Give enough execution, synchronization, and on-chip-memory detail to reconstruct the displayed QuACK kernel path from its CuTeDSL implementation.
authoring.audience: GPU kernel engineers familiar with CuTeDSL, cooperative reductions, TMA, WGMMA, and UMMA.
reading_order: entry point and active execution roles
the implementation-specific invariant that distinguishes the kernel
required_content: name the inspected kernel entry point
state whether execution is cooperative or warp-specialized
show major data movement and compute operations
show SMEM and TMEM usage, including explicit non-use
